feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 August 2026 11:39am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 08 August 2026 at 11:35am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over Eastern Europe will continue to drift eastwards, allowing weak weather fronts to move across the Irish Sea tonight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

Mainly South or Southwest 4 or 5 today, but locally Variable 2 or 3 at times in Liverpool and Morecambe Bay. Becoming West or Southwest 3 or 4 in all waters tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in central and western waters until later.


##Weather##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain and drizzle slowly spreading from the west tonight and tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and drizzle later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, veering Northwest tomorrow evening or early tomorrow night and increasing 4 or 5. Decreasing Northwest 3 or 4 later in night, then 2 or 3 on Monday morning.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight, but building slight or moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Patchy rain and drizzle at first, then becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or in precipitation at first.
